start.title: La pianura di Sinar
start.text:
Una vasta pianura verde si estende davanti.
Tutta l'umanità si è radunata qui — un popolo, una lingua.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Settle and build a home
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You sink roots into the earth. It feels right.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Dream of something greater
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The horizon is not enough. You want the sky.

unity.title: Una lingua
unity.text:
Le voci si fondono. Le risate si levano.
Non c'è parola che tu non possa capire.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Praise God for the gift of unity
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You lift your voice in thanks. Others bow their heads.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Boast of what we could achieve
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Pride sparks in the crowd. Eyes turn upward.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stay silent — listen to the elders
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Wise voices speak softly. Others shout louder.

proposal.title: La grande idea
proposal.text:
Un anziano si alza. «Costruiamo una torre — la sua cima nei cieli».
«Facciamoci un nome.»

choices.text: [TODO:it] Cheer — join the great work
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your voice is one of thousands. The crowd roars.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Speak against it — this is pride
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Few hear you. But the words are spoken.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Wait — let others decide
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Silence is its own answer. The vote passes.

bricks.title: Mattoni e catrame
bricks.text:
Modelli argilla umida in mattoni.
Sono più forti della pietra. Raggiungeranno il cielo.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Work for the love of craft
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your hands move with care. The work itself is good.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Race the others — outshine them
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your speed turns to recklessness. Bricks crack.

construction.title: I primi piani
construction.text:
Le mura si ergono. La torre proietta una lunga ombra.
Gli uomini cantano mentre sollevano ogni trave.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Boast — "We need no God now"
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Workers cheer. Above, the silence deepens.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Work quietly — say a prayer
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] No one hears. But the prayer is heard above.

rising.title: Più in alto
rising.text:
Anno dopo anno. Pietra su pietra.
La torre trafigge le nuvole.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Doubt — should we stop?
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You whisper it. The wind carries the words away.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Climb higher — there is no limit
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The ladder feels endless. Your pride is fuel.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Demand the workers go faster
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Tempers fray. Hands bleed. The tower climbs.

summit.title: Toccando il cielo
summit.text:
Stai in cima. La terra è piccola sotto.
I cieli sembrano vicini — quasi a portata di mano.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Reach upward — claim the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your fingers find only wind. Yet you feel watched.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Kneel — feel suddenly small
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The vastness above swallows your pride.

gods_gaze.title: Egli Discende
gods_gaze.text:
Una voce riempie l'aria, calma come un tuono.
"Essi sono un solo popolo. Nulla sarà loro impossibile."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stand defiant before the voice
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your courage withers. The air grows heavy.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Bow your head in fear and awe
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your knees buckle. The presence is everywhere.

confusion.title: Strane Parole
confusion.text:
Chiami il tuo amico. Ti fissa.
La sua bocca si apre — ma i suoni non hanno senso.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Force him to understand — shout louder
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Anger only deepens the void between you.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Step back — accept what God has done
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Tears fall. The wall between you is unbreakable.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Blame the elders — start a fight
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Fists fly. The tower bleeds men instead of mortar.

scattering.title: Partenza
scattering.text:
Le famiglie raccolgono ciò che possono.
Ogni gruppo cammina verso un orizzonte diverso.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Curse the heavens as you leave
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Bitterness is a heavy load to carry.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Walk in silence, lesson in heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Each step is a small confession.

reflection.title: Una Nuova Terra
reflection.text:
Ti fermi su una cresta silenziosa.
La torre è lontana — un ricordo di orgoglio.
